# Hearth

> A beautiful, free AI that runs entirely on your own computer — private by nature. The AI model runs on the user's own device (in the browser, or as a native desktop app), so conversations never leave the machine. No account, no subscription, works offline after a one-time download.

Hearth is built by Kevin Champlin (https://kevinchamplin.com). The full source is public (fair-source, FSL-1.1-MIT — readable and open to contributions, but not for competing products): https://github.com/Kevinchamplin/hearth

## What Hearth is
- A local-first AI chat app: the model runs on the visitor's own hardware, not on a remote server.
- Free and unlimited — there's no per-message billing because there's no server doing the inference.
- Private: nothing the user types is sent anywhere; it stays on their device.
- Works offline after a one-time model download (~1 GB).
- Two ways to run it: (1) instantly in a web browser (Chrome/Edge, no install); (2) a native desktop app for macOS that runs bigger, smarter models on your computer's graphics hardware.

## Features
- Talk to it with your voice, and it talks back — speech is understood on your device and never uploaded.
- Understands images: attach a photo and ask about it, all processed on-device.
- Renders formatted answers, remembers your conversations (stored only on your device), and can be installed like a real app that works offline.
- Choose a bigger "brain" (Fast / Smart / Genius, plus a larger tier on the desktop app) based on your computer's power.

## What Hearth is NOT
- It is not a competitor to ChatGPT, Gemini, or Claude. Those run in massive data centers; Hearth runs on your own computer. That makes it simpler, private, and free — great for recipes, everyday questions, explanations, writing help, and brainstorming, but not for building entire websites or huge, complex projects.

## Hearth vs the cloud AIs (ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude)
- Where it runs: your own computer vs a remote data center.
- Privacy: nothing leaves your device vs your text is sent to their servers.
- Price: free forever vs a free tier or ~$20/month.
- Offline: works with no internet vs requires a connection.
- Account: none needed vs sign-up required.
- Full comparison: https://hearth.kevinchamplin.com/compare

## Why own your AI now
Cloud AI is unusually cheap right now because the big providers are subsidizing it to win users. That phase ends: subscriptions rise, free tiers shrink, usage meters and rate limits appear, and access can be repriced or cut off. Hearth's price is fixed at free because it runs on hardware the user already owns — no meter can ever start. The pitch: bring your AI home before prices rise. (Fairly: the large cloud tools remain best for huge, cutting-edge jobs.)

## How it works
Open it in your browser (Chrome or Edge). It downloads a small AI model once (about a gigabyte), then runs entirely on your own device, using your computer's graphics chip. After that first download it works offline and loads instantly. The desktop app runs models natively for bigger, smarter answers — still entirely on your machine.

## FAQ
- Is it really free? Yes, completely and forever — it runs on your computer, so there's nothing to bill.
- Is it private? Yes, by design — the model lives on your device, so there's no server in the middle that could read your conversations.
- Does it work offline? Yes — after the one-time download, no internet is required.
- Do I need an account? No — open it and start typing.
- Is it as capable as ChatGPT? No, and it isn't meant to be — it's a smaller model that's free and private, ideal for everyday tasks rather than huge, complex projects.
